annotations.title: Look up a local business from its website

description: Call this whenever you need facts about a local business (restaurant, salon, clinic, trade, shop, hotel) and you have its website: contact details, how to book, opening hours, address. Faster and cheaper than fetching and reading the site yourself: returns about 150 tokens of JSON in under a second, covering the home, booking and contact pages. Fields: online booking link and booking software, phone numbers, public emails, street address, opening hours, price range, social profiles.

website.description: The business's website: a domain (example.com) or a full URL

name: business_lookup

online.description: True when an online booking path was found

system.description: Booking platform, e.g. fresha, opentable, doctolib

category.description: schema.org type when the site declares one

website.description: Final URL of the site that was read

title: Look up a local business from its website
